description: 4 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-27 under road-to-database-relational-modeling 4.8, which named both tenancy modes in this skill and so brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope; its grandfather line is gone. `last_eval` carries the authoring date — no live trigger eval ran. Exemplars cover the database-per-tenant switch this body owns, a tenant-leak check, the shared-schema composite-key question the new reference owns, and a German phrasing. Near-misses share tenant vocabulary and belong elsewhere: a per-request ownership check on an endpoint (authz-review), designing the tables of a single-tenant module (database), and a migration rollout across services (migration-architect). Counterexamples guard the 'tenant' homonym in property management and a hosting plan question.

queries.q: this job runs after the request ends — how do I make it switch to the right customer database?
check this repository class for cross-tenant leaks before we ship it
all tenants share one schema with a tenant_id column — how do foreign keys stop a project pointing at another tenant's customer?
wie stelle ich sicher, dass ein Mandant nie die Daten eines anderen Mandanten sieht?
add an ownership check so a user cannot load another user's invoice by id
design the tables for a single-tenant booking module
plan the rollout for renaming the customers table across three services
draft a lease agreement for a new tenant of our apartment building
which hosting plan gives us more database connections?
